name: consent-ledger
title: Consent Ledger
description: A permissions list where every grant stays individually revocable in the same view, not filed away in a settings sub-menu: the same switch that revokes a grant restores it, instantly, no confirmation dialog either direction. A dependency panel underneath shows exactly which mocked features that grant was powering, and the moment it's revoked, an animated strike draws itself across every feature that actually needed it, live.
